name: BLANKET CAT
source:
"Oh! Come in, Come in--
And let us begin,
There's no need to delay:
"How are you feeling today?"
♥ The Kitchen Witch Creed, Verse 3 ♥

Told in second person, you will directly experience the world as Iggy. Baba, your witch, is heading to the store, so that gives you plenty of time for... activities! 

Hunt, sleep, or explore in this short visual novel about found family, platonic love, and a pastoral life.

Our time together is short. Try not to worry about anything else.

[From [url=https://ghostlegs.itch.io/blanket-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“哦！进来吧，进来——
让我们开始吧，
没有必要拖延：
“今天感觉怎么样？”
♥ 厨房女巫信条，第3节 ♥

以第二人称讲述，你将直接体验伊吉的世界。你的女巫爸爸要去商店，这样你就有足够的时间进行……活动！

在这部关于家庭、柏拉图式爱情和田园生活的短篇视觉小说中狩猎、睡觉或探索。

我们在一起的时间很短。尽量不要担心其他事情。”

[来自[url=https://ghostlegs.itch.io/blanket-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
